FINDING: The Illankai Tamil Arasu Kachchi (ITAK), a Sri Lankan political party representing the Sri Lankan Tamil ethnic minority, is associated with the aim of developing a national identity based on shared characteristics and preserving the nation's culture. ITAK was originally formed in 1949 as a breakaway faction of the All Ceylon Tamil Congress (ACTC) and later merged with the ACTC and Ceylon Workers' Congress (CWC) to form the Tamil United Front, which later changed its name to Tamil United Liberation Front. ITAK remained dormant until 2004 when a split in the TULF resulted in ITAK being re-established as an active political party. ITAK is a constituent party of the Tamil National Alliance.
